de37_palantir_israel.topic: Palantir and Israel: partnership wording, Karp's statements, UN rapporteur report and Palantir's replies, the Lebanon book claim, investor and customer exits; other states' documented ties to the network

claims.text: Bloomberg 12 Jan 2024: Palantir EVP Josh Harris confirmed a strategic partnership agreed at a Thursday meeting in Tel Aviv attended by Israeli defence officials, Thiel and Karp: 'Both parties have mutually agreed to harness Palantir's advanced technology in support of war-related missions'; 'aims to significantly aid the Israeli Ministry of Defense in addressing the current situation'; no terms or figures disclosed; Karp said demand in Israel had been high since 7 Oct

CNBC 13 Mar 2024: Karp said 'We've lost employees. I'm sure we'll lose employees'; on the February earnings call he said he was 'exceedingly proud that after Oct. 7, within weeks, we are on the ground'; in October 2023 Palantir ran a full-page NYT ad saying it 'stands with Israel'

The National 6 May 2025: at the Hill and Valley Forum in Washington (late April 2025) a protester said Palantir's AI kills Palestinians; Karp replied 'Mostly terrorists that's true' and, after she was removed, 'She believes I'm evil, and I believe she's an unwitting product of an evil force, Hamas'

MEE 1 Jul 2025: Albanese's report (A/HRC/59/23) says 'There are reasonable grounds to believe Palantir has provided automatic predictive policing technology', 'core defence infrastructure' and its AI Platform for 'real-time battlefield data integration for automated decision making'; report says the collaboration predates October 2023

Palantir to BHRRC 21 Apr 2025 (Bowman): 'Our work in Israel predates the terror attack, and is in line with our global support of US allies and liberal democracies'; Gospel and Lavender claims 'are not true'; both 'independent of and pre-date' the MOD partnership; 'no involvement with the Lavender database used by the IDF'; TITAN 'has no connection to our work in the region'

MEE 10 Dec 2025: Steinberger's biography of Karp says Palantir's technology 'was deployed by the Israelis during military operations in Lebanon in 2024' and 'was also used in Operation Grim Beeper' (pagers, 17 Sept 2024), and a team of engineers was sent from London; the book does not say how; no Palantir response reported

iTnews 4 Sep 2026: Coles and Palantir agreed to 'conclude their partnership', not expected to run beyond 2027; Coles: software 'deployed within Coles' own environment', Palantir 'does not control the data'; GetUp! campaign (86,000 signatures) on worker-surveillance grounds; article does not mention Israel

CBS 27 Nov 2023: Musk visited Israel, toured Kfar Aza with Netanyahu; Communications Minister Karhi: Starlink units 'can only be operated in Israel with the approval of the Israeli Ministry of Communications', 'including the Gaza Strip'; Musk had called an antisemitic post 'the actual truth'; White House: 'abhorrent promotion of antisemitic and racist hate'

Forward 29 Nov 2023: post of 15 Nov 2023 claimed 'Jewish communities have been pushing the exact kind of dialectical hatred against whites'; Musk replied 'the actual truth'; at DealBook he said 'I'm sorry for that post. It was foolish of me', possibly 'the worst and dumbest post'; Israel trip 'not an apology tour'

State Dept 9 Jul 2025: Rubio designated Albanese under EO 14203 s.1(a)(ii)(A), citing her engagement with the ICC and 'threatening letters to dozens of entities worldwide' including 'major American companies across finance, technology, defense, energy, and hospitality', and recommending ICC investigation of those companies; statement accuses her of antisemitism

Bloomberg Law 19 Nov 2025: Musk said xAI plans a 500 MW data centre in Saudi Arabia with Humain, 'the kingdom's state-backed AI venture', using Nvidia chips, announced at a US-Saudi investment forum in Washington
Shanghai government 7 Jan 2026: Tesla's Shanghai plant delivered 851,000 vehicles in 2025, 52% of Tesla's global deliveries
